article.title: Which are the best Persian carpets?
article.excerpt: I think there are three which stand above all the others: 1. The Ardabil carpet, at the Victoria & Albert Museum in London . Here is one on-line image , here is an excerpt . I find this angle useful, but nothing compares to the real thing. 2. The “Tree Carpet” in the Philadelphia Museum of Art . 3. Jagdteppich (“Hunting carpet”), Museum für Angewandte Kuns
